verses.he: מַֽעֲנֶה־רַּ֭ךְ יָשִׁ֣יב חֵמָ֑ה וּדְבַר־עֶ֝֗צֶב יַעֲלֶה־אָֽף׃
verses.en: A soft answer turneth away wrath; But a grievous word stirreth up anger.

verses.he: לְשׁ֣וֹן חֲ֭כָמִים תֵּיטִ֣יב דָּ֑עַת וּפִ֥י כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.en: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright; But the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.

verses.he: בְּֽכָל־מָ֭קוֹם עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה צֹ֝פ֗וֹת רָעִ֥ים וטוֹבִֽים׃
verses.en: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, Keeping watch upon the evil and the good.

verses.he: מַרְפֵּ֣א לָ֭שׁוֹן עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְסֶ֥לֶף בָּ֝֗הּ שֶׁ֣בֶר בְּרֽוּחַ׃
verses.en: A soothing tongue is a tree of life; But perverseness therein is a wound to the spirit.

verses.he: אֱוִ֗יל יִ֭נְאַץ מוּסַ֣ר אָבִ֑יו וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹכַ֣חַת יַעְרִֽם׃
verses.en: A fool despiseth his father’s correction; But he that regardeth reproof is prudent.

verses.he: בֵּ֣ית צַ֭דִּיק חֹ֣סֶן רָ֑ב וּבִתְבוּאַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע נֶעְכָּֽרֶת׃
verses.en: In the house of the righteous is much treasure; But in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.

verses.he: שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲ֭כָמִים יְזָ֣רוּ דָ֑עַת וְלֵ֖ב כְּסִילִ֣ים לֹא־כֵֽן׃
verses.en: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge; But the heart of the foolish is not stedfast.

verses.he: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּתְפִלַּ֖ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD; But the prayer of the upright is His delight.

verses.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ רָשָׁ֑ע וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף צְדָקָ֣ה יֶאֱהָֽב׃
verses.en: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD; But He loveth him that followeth after righteousness.

verses.he: מוּסָ֣ר רָ֭ע לְעֹזֵ֣ב אֹ֑רַח שׂוֹנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת יָמֽוּת׃
verses.en: There is grievous correction for him that forsaketh the way; And he that hateth reproof shall die.

verses.he: שְׁא֣וֹל וַ֭אֲבַדּוֹן נֶ֣גֶד יְהוָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־לִבּ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: The nether-world and Destruction are before the LORD; How much more then the hearts of the children of men!

verses.he: לֹ֣א יֶאֱהַב־לֵ֭ץ הוֹכֵ֣חַֽ ל֑וֹ אֶל־חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א יֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.en: A scorner loveth not to be reproved; He will not go unto the wise.

verses.he: לֵ֣ב שָׂ֭מֵחַ יֵיטִ֣ב פָּנִ֑ים וּבְעַצְּבַת־לֵ֝ב ר֣וּחַ נְכֵאָֽה׃
verses.en: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance; But by sorrow of heart the spirit is broken.

verses.he: לֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן יְבַקֶּשׁ־דָּ֑עַת ופני [וּפִ֥י] כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יִרְעֶ֥ה אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.en: The heart of him that hath discernment seeketh knowledge; But the mouth of fools feedeth on folly.

verses.he: כָּל־יְמֵ֣י עָנִ֣י רָעִ֑ים וְטֽוֹב־לֵ֝֗ב מִשְׁתֶּ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃
verses.en: All the days of the poor are evil; But he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.

verses.he: טוֹב־מְ֭עַט בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה מֵאוֹצָ֥ר רָ֝֗ב וּמְה֥וּמָה בֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Better is little with the fear of the LORD, Than great treasure and turmoil therewith.

verses.he: ט֤וֹב אֲרֻחַ֣ת יָ֭רָק וְאַהֲבָה־שָׁ֑ם מִשּׁ֥וֹר אָ֝ב֗וּס וְשִׂנְאָה־בֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, Than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.

verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ חֵ֭מָה יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וְאֶ֥רֶך אַ֝פַּ֗יִם יַשְׁקִ֥יט רִֽיב׃
verses.en: A wrathful man stirreth up discord; But he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.

verses.he: דֶּ֣רֶךְ עָ֭צֵל כִּמְשֻׂ֣כַת חָ֑דֶק וְאֹ֖רַח יְשָׁרִ֣ים סְלֻלָֽה׃
verses.en: The way of the sluggard is as though hedged by thorns; But the path of the upright is even.

verses.he: בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם יְשַׂמַּח־אָ֑ב וּכְסִ֥יל אָ֝דָ֗ם בּוֹזֶ֥ה אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: A wise son maketh a glad father; But a foolish man despiseth his mother.

verses.he: אִ֭וֶּלֶת שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַחֲסַר־לֵ֑ב וְאִ֥ישׁ תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה יְיַשֶּׁר־לָֽכֶת׃
verses.en: Folly is joy to him that lacketh understanding; But a man of discernment walketh straightforwards.

verses.he: הָפֵ֣ר מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת בְּאֵ֣ין ס֑וֹד וּבְרֹ֖ב יוֹעֲצִ֣ים תָּקֽוּם׃
verses.en: For want of counsel purposes are frustrated; But in the multitude of counsellors they are established.

verses.he: שִׂמְחָ֣ה לָ֭אִישׁ בְּמַעֲנֵה־פִ֑יו וְדָבָ֖ר בְּעִתּ֣וֹ מַה־טּֽוֹב׃
verses.en: A man hath joy in the answer of his mouth; And a word in due season, how good is it!

verses.he: אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים לְמַ֣עְלָה לְמַשְׂכִּ֑יל לְמַ֥עַן ס֝֗וּר מִשְּׁא֥וֹל מָֽטָּה׃
verses.en: The path of life goeth upward for the wise, that he may depart from the nether-world beneath.

verses.he: בֵּ֣ית גֵּ֭אִים יִסַּ֥ח׀ יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝יַצֵּ֗ב גְּב֣וּל אַלְמָנָֽה׃
verses.en: The LORD will pluck up the house of the proud; But He will establish the border of the widow.

verses.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת רָ֑ע וּ֝טְהֹרִ֗ים אִמְרֵי־נֹֽעַם׃
verses.en: The thoughts of wickedness are an abomination to the LORD; But words of pleasantness are pure.

verses.he: עֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭יתוֹ בּוֹצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע וְשׂוֹנֵ֖א מַתָּנֹ֣ת יִחְיֶֽה׃
verses.en: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; But he that hateth gifts shall live.

verses.he: לֵ֣ב צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה לַעֲנ֑וֹת וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ רָעֽוֹת׃
verses.en: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer; But the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.

verses.he: רָח֣וֹק יְ֭הוָה מֵרְשָׁעִ֑ים וּתְפִלַּ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.en: The LORD is far from the wicked; But He heareth the prayer of the righteous.

verses.he: מְֽאוֹר־עֵ֭ינַיִם יְשַׂמַּֽח־לֵ֑ב שְׁמוּעָ֥ה ט֝וֹבָ֗ה תְּדַשֶּׁן־עָֽצֶם׃
verses.en: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart; And a good report maketh the bones fat.

verses.he: אֹ֗זֶן שֹׁ֖מַעַת תּוֹכַ֣חַת חַיִּ֑ים בְּקֶ֖רֶב חֲכָמִ֣ים תָּלִֽין׃
verses.en: The ear that hearkeneth to the reproof of life abideth among the wise.

verses.he: פּוֹרֵ֣עַ מ֭וּסָר מוֹאֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְשׁוֹמֵ֥עַ תּ֝וֹכַ֗חַת ק֣וֹנֶה לֵּֽב׃
verses.en: He that refuseth correction despiseth his own soul; But he that hearkeneth to reproof getteth understanding.

verses.he: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מוּסַ֣ר חָכְמָ֑ה וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָב֣וֹד עֲנָוָֽה׃
verses.en: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; And before honour goeth humility.
